summary.text: Richard Tripp is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives for Rockingham 13 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8 Republican primary.
Ballotpedia lists him as a U.S. Navy veteran who served as a Derry town councilor from 2015 to 2021.

paragraphs.text: Richard Tripp lives in New Hampshire, served in the U.S. Navy, and volunteered as a Derry town councilor from 2015 to 2021, according to Ballotpedia.
He was assigned to the Municipal and County Government Committee for the 2021-2022 session and to the House Judiciary Committee for 2023-2024.
